test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

If you want scoring well / in the examination, / your answers must be to the point.

options.text: your answers must be to the point

solution:
The erroneous part is **"If you want scoring well"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the first part of the sentence "**If you want scoring well"**

 
 
• **​**In this part of the sentence the word "**IF"** is showing condition
 
• The use of want is correct according to the subject "**You".****​**
 
• Here "**Want"** is working as a **Main verb.**
 
• There are some verbs in English that are followed by "**To + Main Verb" **
 
 
• **​Example:- **
 
 
• **​**I want to **becoming** a doctor **(Wrong)**.
 
• I want **to become** a doctor **(Correct)**
 
 
 
 
 
• **​**Hence, according to this concept, the error lies in part A of the sentence i.e. option no 4.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence is *"If you want** to score** well in the examination, your answers must be to the point." *
